review.use_summary: Plotted the CUT&Run chromatin profile with IGV and the WashU browser across the reported chromosome2 interval20404583–58108703.
review.implementation_scope_note: Read trimming,local Bowtie2 mapping,filtering and deepTools coverage preceded display. HOMER generated the separate average profile. The paragraph does not specify the IGV version,assembly,track scale or session;the long interval is retained as reported.

review.use_summary: Generated genome-track screenshots in Integrative Genomics Viewer from genome-coverage-normalized(RPGC) data.
review.implementation_scope_note: RPGC normalization was supplied upstream;this is a visualization role. The appended99 is a citation,not an IGV version. Track files,assembly,view range and scale are not given in this paragraph.

review.use_summary: Visualized deepTools bamCoverage-normalized ATAC-seq signal in IGV v2.7.0 after mm10 alignment,filtering and strand-specific Tn5 shifts.
review.implementation_scope_note: Trim Galore,BWA-MEM,read filtering,+4/−5 shifting and MACS2 peak calling were separate upstream operations. The IGV snapshot scale,locus and complete normalization settings are not specified;display is not a peak caller.

review.use_summary: Visualized human regions syntenic to mouse chromosomes with custom SEG files in IGV and generated human summary plots from combined segmentation files;Affinity Designer prepared the final artwork.
review.implementation_scope_note: Cinteny supplied synteny,while methylation-derived copy-number data and the threshold/enrichment/t-test procedure were separate inputs and analyses. IGV is not identified as performing that statistical procedure. Version and session parameters are unstated.

review.use_summary: Manually screened default-filtered Manta structural-variant calls involving BCL2 and MYC using Integrative Genomics Viewer v2.7.2.
review.implementation_scope_note: Manta called the rearrangements. Supporting breakpoint reads and locus coverage were used for allele-frequency estimation,but the source does not specify an IGV counting command,display filters or an automated adjudication rule.

review.use_summary: Manually inspected Minimap2-aligned HiFi reads at structural-variant breakpoints with IGV v2.9.2 while evaluating32 accession assemblies at304 loci.
review.implementation_scope_note: Minimap2 generated alignments and the assembly/quality tools performed separate tasks. Juicebox handled the stated Hi-C inspection. The paragraph does not provide exact IGV loci,read filters or a reproducible manual acceptance rule.

review.use_summary: Used Integrative Genomics Viewer visualization with Minimap2-aligned ONT reads to identify split reads and estimate assembly gaps before gap closure.
review.implementation_scope_note: NextDenovo assemblies,manual gap decisions and HiFi polishing were separate operations;IGV visualization alone does not reconstruct the genome or validate gap closure. The appended73 is a citation,not a version.

review.use_summary: Obtained ChIP-seq visualization snapshots with IGV v2.19.1 from RPGC-normalized BigWig tracks generated by deepTools bamCoverage.
review.implementation_scope_note: Alignment,MAPQ/blacklist filtering,duplicate removal,MACS3 peak calling and HOMER motif analysis were separate tools. No IGV scale,colors,locus or session is given. deepTools3.5.4 is not the IGV version.

review.use_summary: Visualized ChIP-seq data with Integrative Genomics Viewer v2.16.0 after mm10 alignment and the stated peak/normalization analysis.
review.implementation_scope_note: Csaw peak calling,loess normalization,GenomicRanges promoter assignment and EdgeR differential enrichment are separate operations. The paragraph does not specify an IGV normalization,statistical test or snapshot recipe.

review.use_summary: Visualized CUT&Tag bigWig tracks in IGV 2.4.15 and separately used IGV for classical ChIP bigWig visualization.
review.implementation_scope_note: A native BED export does not establish an interactive IGV session, the displayed reference/track scales or inspection results. No such session was reproduced.

review.use_summary: Visualized Minimap2/SAMtools-processed PacBio HiFi seed alignments in IGV v2.8.13 during iterative pseudoautosomal-region assembly walking and manually selected reads matching the seed over4kb.
review.implementation_scope_note: Read selection was a manual step with stated mutation/polymorphism exceptions. CAP3 assembly,YASS self-similarity and BLASTN comparisons were separate tools. An IGV view does not implement the walking/contig-choice/merge algorithm or its manual decisions.

review.use_summary: Manually curated CNVs in Integrative Genomics Viewer v2.12.2 after GATK calling and comparison with genomic segments shared by affected relatives.
review.implementation_scope_note: GATK used1000bp GRCh37/hg19 intervals for CNV calling. DECIPHER screened common CNVs separately. No IGV CNV caller,co-segregation algorithm,view scale or automated manual-review replacement is specified.

review.use_summary: Reported IGV v2.12.3 among the tools used to visualize Hi-C contacts and annotated features,together with Juicebox,HiCExplorer and pyGenomeTracks.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paragraph lists visualization alternatives without assigning a specific file format,panel or transformation to each tool. It does not establish that IGV loaded a .hic matrix or performed NMF,RobusTAD or copy-number statistics.

review.use_summary: Independently reviewed methylation-containing HiFi BAMs in IGV with two scientists,inspecting relevant CpG islands in positive and control samples;the Results also note a mosaic SCN1A deletion visible in IGV despite a missed automatic call.
review.implementation_scope_note: pb-CpG-tools calculated methylation values after ccs/pbmm2 preprocessing. Displaying methylation requires the actual BAM modification tags,reference and viewer settings. Neither the viewer version nor an automatic diagnostic rule is specified;the visual mosaic finding is distinct from a successful pipeline call.

review.use_summary: Used IGV read-depth analysis of blood-derived ONT TMEM216 transcripts to assess allele imbalance in a carrier,reporting23,255 versus8,184 reads(74%/26%) at the linked coding SNV. Supporting Results describe inspection of apparent homozygotes and the cDNA-read display.
review.implementation_scope_note: This is direct primary Results evidence,manually selected by its exact paragraph hash rather than inferred from a Methods heading. Trio segregation and read inspection checked zygosity;the linked c.264G>A SNV distinguishes transcript alleles,while the c.−69 base is outside the displayed RNA. Version,read/base-quality thresholds,downsampling and overlap-counting rules are unstated;do not equate displayed counts with an unspecified generic pileup.

review.implementation_scope_note: RNA preparation,STAR alignment and BAM processing were upstream. The paragraph does not give an IGV version,splice-view settings or an automated NMD/splicing test.

Viewer version and display/counting settings are unstated;ShinyGO,MRSD,MAJIQ-CAT and other statistical tools remain separate.
